Project Overview

Maxim Thermal Engineering successfully completed the manufacturing and installation of AHU (Air Handling Unit) condenser coils for an Engro facility. This project demonstrates our expertise in delivering high-quality HVAC engineering solutions designed to improve cooling efficiency, operational reliability, and long-term performance in demanding industrial environments.

From manufacturing to installation, our engineering team ensured that every condenser coil met strict quality standards and was installed with precision to support uninterrupted plant operations.

Scope of Work

For this project, Maxim Thermal Engineering provided comprehensive engineering services, including:

  • Manufacturing of custom AHU condenser coils
  • Quality inspection and testing
  • Transportation and on-site handling
  • Professional installation
  • System alignment and fitting
  • Final inspection and commissioning support

Every stage of the project was completed following industry best practices and a strong commitment to quality workmanship.

Engineering Excellence

Our condenser coils are manufactured using high-quality materials and advanced engineering practices to ensure reliable heat transfer, corrosion resistance, and long service life. Each solution is developed to meet the specific operational requirements of industrial HVAC systems.
